title: Choice Moment
prompt:
Byleth looks toward Dimitri across the hall. Dimitri receives the gaze with surprise, gratitude, and restrained responsibility. The moment should make the Blue Lions choice feel human, not mechanical. Keep Dimitri young, noble, sincere, and not war-phase.

Camera: intimate close decision shot, shallow depth of field.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: exaggerated smile, kingly older styling, menu-like presentation. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
